04 / QUESTIONS

Questions before you choose.

How do rotating and static residential proxies differ?+

Rotating residential proxies change IPs according to their configuration. Static residential proxies suit tasks that need a relatively fixed exit. Confirm rotation rules, IP allocation and session settings for the selected product.

How can I check whether a product fits my workflow?+

List your target sites, locations, usage and protocol requirements, then confirm available configurations with support. Run a small test after setup; results depend on the target service and network conditions.

Where can I find pricing and available locations?+

Check current product information in the original console or contact us by email below. Billing and available locations may differ by proxy type.

What should I consider when using proxies?+

Follow applicable laws, the target service terms and access rules, and ensure you have appropriate permission to access the relevant data and systems.
